title: MemoryView
description: data of GET /v1/memory (Perfil, "Lo que Neural Ledger sabe de ti") and of the confirmation and Perfil writes (ADR-048): per chain, the version that applies today, the next one if it starts later, and what the statements say about it. Without the memory consent, `items` still lists the declarations so the user can delete them, but `check` is null and nothing is applied. A shared persona has no items.

versions.description: How many versions the chain holds; the export lists them all.

current.description: The version that applies to the pay month of today; null when every version starts later.

upcoming.description: The next version, when it starts after the pay month of today.
